sections.title: Text 1

blocks.zh: 王一飞：你觉得老妈穿这件毛衣怎么样？
blocks.en: Wang: How would this sweater look on Mum?

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：样子不错，就是颜色好像不怎么适合她。
blocks.en: Yang: The style is nice, but the colour may not suit her.

blocks.zh: 售货员：老年人穿这种颜色的衣服正合适，颜色不深，质量还特别好。您看那位阿姨正试着呢，是不是很好看？
blocks.en: Assistant: This colour suits older people. It is not dark, and the quality is excellent. Look at that lady trying it; doesn’t it look good?

blocks.zh: 王一飞：嗯，是挺不错的。同乐，我印象中，老妈也常穿这种颜色的衣服，她应该会喜欢的，买一件吧。
blocks.en: Wang: Yes. I remember Mum wearing this colour often. She should like it; let’s buy one.

blocks.zh: 杨同乐：好的，老妈高兴比什么都强。
blocks.en: Yang: All right. Mum’s happiness matters most.

blocks.zh: 售货员：就是，老人开心最重要。我们店正好年底有活动，全场打七折呢，挺值的。
blocks.en: Assistant: Exactly. We have a year-end offer: thirty percent off everything, excellent value.

blocks.zh: 售货员认为老人穿那件毛衣怎么样？
blocks.en: What does the assistant think of the sweater for an older person?

answers.zh: 颜色正合适，不深，质量也好。
answers.en: The colour suits them, is not dark, and the quality is good.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 杨同乐最后为什么愿意买那件毛衣了？
blocks.en: Why does Yang agree to buy it?

answers.zh: 因为母亲应该会喜欢，母亲高兴最重要。
answers.en: His mother should like it, and her happiness matters most.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 杨同乐和王一飞去商场给父母买衣服。王一飞选了一件毛衣后问杨同乐……，杨同乐觉得样子还可以，但是颜色……。售货员说老年人穿这种颜色……，……，质量也好。王一飞也觉得不错，认为老妈也常穿……，她会……。杨同乐说，老妈高兴……。售货员告诉他们，现在店里正好……，全场……，挺值的。
prompt.en: They shop for their parents. Wang asks…. Yang likes the style but…. The assistant says the colour…and quality…. Mum often wears…and should…. Her happiness…. The shop has…and everything is….

answer.zh: 杨同乐和王一飞给母亲买毛衣。杨同乐觉得样子不错，但颜色不怎么适合母亲。售货员说颜色正合适，不深，质量很好。王一飞说母亲常穿这种颜色，应该会喜欢。杨同乐觉得母亲高兴最重要。商场年底全场打七折，所以很值。
answer.en: Yang and Wang buy a sweater for Mum. He doubts the colour, but the assistant says it suits older people and has good quality. Wang remembers Mum wearing that colour. Yang agrees her happiness matters most. The year-end thirty-percent discount makes it good value.

sections.title: Text 2

blocks.zh: 刘明：爷爷、奶奶还没回来呢？
blocks.en: Liu: Haven’t Grandpa and Grandma returned?

blocks.zh: 王一雪：没呢，估计快了。下午老年班举办一期听力保护活动，他们去参加活动了。
blocks.en: Wang: Not yet, probably soon. They attended a hearing-protection activity at the senior class this afternoon.

blocks.zh: 刘明：他们的活动还挺丰富的！
blocks.en: Liu: Their activities are quite varied!

blocks.zh: 王一雪：嗯。小明最近要考试，心里有点儿烦，昨天因为脱、挂衣服这点儿小事，就对奶奶发脾气了。
blocks.en: Wang: Xiaoming is bothered about his exams. Yesterday he lost his temper with Grandma over taking off and hanging up clothes.

blocks.zh: 刘明：是吗？他这样做老人该伤心了。
blocks.en: Liu: Really? That must have upset her.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：就是啊。他也不是不知道自己错了，我批评他以后，他马上说放学回来就向奶奶道歉。
blocks.en: Wang: Yes. He knows he was wrong. After I criticised him, he promised to apologise after school.

blocks.zh: 刘明：好的，我也再跟他聊聊。
blocks.en: Liu: I will talk to him too.

blocks.zh: 王一雪：那就更好了。
blocks.en: Wang: That would be even better.

blocks.zh: 小明因为什么对奶奶发了脾气？
blocks.en: Why did Xiaoming lose his temper?

answers.zh: 因为脱、挂衣服的小事，也因为考试前心里烦。
answers.en: Over taking off and hanging clothes, while stressed about exams.

answers.zh: 王一雪批评他，他答应放学后向奶奶道歉。
answers.en: She criticised him; he promised to apologise after school.

sections.title: Text 3

blocks.zh: 杨同乐的老家在上海，他自毕业后一直在北京工作。虽然没和父母生活在一起，但父子、母子关系特别好。杨同乐很关心父母，无论平时工作有多忙，他每个周末都会给父母打电话。条件允许时，他会回上海看父母。
blocks.en: Yang’s hometown is Shanghai, but he has worked in Beijing since graduation. Though living apart, he is very close to his parents. However busy he is, he calls every weekend and visits Shanghai when possible.

blocks.zh: 刘明和王一雪结婚后，一直没有和父母生活在一起，他们平时会另外找时间去看父母，帮父母做做饭，打扫打扫卫生。这两年，刘明的母亲身体不太好，他们很担心，就把父母接到了自己家里照顾。父母待在他们身边，他们也终于能放心地去工作了。
blocks.en: After marriage, Liu and Wang lived separately from their parents but visited to cook and clean. When Liu’s mother’s health declined over the past two years, they brought the parents into their home. Having them nearby allowed them to work with peace of mind.

blocks.zh: 杨同乐是怎么关心父母的？
blocks.en: How does Yang care for his parents?

answers.zh: 每个周末给他们打电话，条件允许时回上海看他们。
answers.en: He calls every weekend and visits Shanghai when possible.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 刘明和王一雪为什么要把父母接到自己家里？
blocks.en: Why did Liu and Wang bring their parents home?

answers.zh: 因为母亲身体不好，他们想照顾父母。
answers.en: His mother was unwell and they wanted to care for them.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 2

sections.note: Retell this text in your own words

prompt.zh: 杨同乐的老家……，他自毕业后一直在……。虽然没和父母……，但……特别好。杨同乐很关心父母，无论……，他每个周末都会……。条件允许时，他会……。刘明和王一雪结婚后，一直没有和父母……，他们平时会……去看父母，帮父母……，……。这两年，刘明的……，他们……，就把父母……。父母待在他们身边，他们也终于能……。
prompt.en: Yang’s hometown is…and he works…. Although living apart, their relationship…. Regardless of…, he calls…. When possible he…. Liu and Wang visited their parents to…and…. When his mother…, they brought them…. Now they can….

answer.zh: 杨同乐的老家在上海，毕业后一直在北京工作。他和父母关系很好，无论多忙，每周末都打电话，条件允许时就回上海看父母。刘明和王一雪原来另外找时间看父母，帮他们做饭、打扫卫生。后来刘明的母亲身体不好，他们把父母接到家里照顾，这样终于可以放心地工作。
answer.en: Yang works in Beijing and keeps close contact with his parents in Shanghai through calls and visits. Liu and Wang used to visit to cook and clean; when his mother became unwell, they brought both parents home and could work reassured.

sections.title: Grammar 3 · 无论……都／也……

blocks.zh: 无论平时工作有多忙，他每个周末都会给父母打电话。
blocks.en: However busy he is, he calls his parents every weekend.

blocks.zh: 只要你努力了，无论你考多少分，你在我们眼里都是最优秀的。
blocks.en: If you tried, whatever your score, you are the best in our eyes.

blocks.zh: 无论你遇到什么困难，我都会在你身边。
blocks.en: Whatever difficulties you face, I will be beside you.

blocks.zh: 她很爱读书，____，都要带上一本书。（待）
blocks.en: She loves reading and takes a book wherever…. (stay)

blocks.zh: 父亲无论多忙，周末____。（陪）
blocks.en: However busy Dad is, on weekends…. (accompany)

answers.en: he always spends time with us

sections.title: Text 4

blocks.zh: 下班回家，林静静将父母从老家寄来的鸡汤热了热，当闻到从小就熟悉的味道时，平时冷静的她鼻子还是酸了。
blocks.en: After work, Lin Jingjing heated chicken soup sent by her parents. Its familiar childhood aroma brought tears to the usually composed woman.

blocks.zh: 林静静一个人来北京工作三年了，父母总是担心她为了节约时间而不好好吃饭，所以每个月都给她寄各种好吃的。这次母亲专门做了林静静最爱喝的鸡汤，为了让食物新鲜，父亲选择了城里最快的快递，上午寄出，下午就能收到。
blocks.en: She has worked alone in Beijing for three years. Worried she neglects meals to save time, her parents send food monthly. Her mother made her favourite soup; her father chose the fastest courier so it arrived the same afternoon, fresh.

blocks.zh: 鸡汤很鲜，林静静心里更暖，她觉得父母好像就在身边。都说“儿行千里母担忧”，父母总对她说：“遇到困难别害怕，要勇敢面对，任何时候都可以和父母商量。”尽管在大城市生活压力有些大，但每当想到父母的这些话，尝到来自老家熟悉的味道，她就觉得又能笑着面对生活了。
blocks.en: The tasty soup warmed her heart, as though her parents were beside her. Parents worry when children travel far. They tell her to face difficulties bravely and consult them anytime. Despite city pressures, their words and familiar food restore her ability to face life with a smile.

blocks.zh: 父亲为什么选择最快的快递？
blocks.en: Why did her father choose the fastest courier?

answers.zh: 为了让食物新鲜，下午就能收到。
answers.en: To keep food fresh and have it arrive that afternoon.

blocks.heading: Read & answer 1

blocks.zh: 是什么让林静静能“笑着面对生活”？
blocks.en: What helps Lin face life with a smile?

answers.zh: 父母关心她的话和老家熟悉的味道。
answers.en: Her parents’ caring words and familiar tastes from home.

blocks.zh: “老妈”是口语中对母亲的一种亲切、亲昵的称呼。
blocks.en: 老妈 is an affectionate informal term for one’s mother.

blocks.zh: 在中国家庭中，常常会按照孩子的辈分来称呼家庭成员，这样更亲切，也方便孩子理解家庭关系。
blocks.en: Chinese families often use the child’s perspective when addressing relatives, making relationships clearer and warmer.

blocks.zh: “儿行千里母担忧”的意思是孩子长大后无论去哪里，父母都担心、牵挂着。
blocks.en: “A mother worries when her child travels far” means parents care about their grown children wherever they go.

blocks.heading: Role-play

blocks.zh: 你喜欢大家庭，还是小家庭？请写一篇短文说明理由，不少于140字。
blocks.en: Do you prefer an extended or nuclear family? Explain why in at least 140 Chinese characters.

answers.zh: 我比较喜欢大家庭，因为一家人住在一起，可以互相照顾。爷爷、奶奶有很多生活经验，我遇到问题时，喜欢听听他们的想法。父母工作忙的时候，家里其他人也能帮忙。晚上大家一起吃饭，聊聊一天发生的事，我觉得很幸福。当然，住在一起也可能有不同的意见。无论谁不开心，我们都应该先冷静下来，好好商量，不能因为一点儿小事就发脾气。如果自己做错了，就要勇敢道歉。我认为幸福的家庭不是从来没有问题，而是每个人都愿意关心别人，为了全家的幸福而一起努力。
answers.en: I prefer an extended family because we can care for one another. Grandparents offer experience and others help when parents are busy. Shared dinners make me happy. Differences still arise, so we should stay calm, discuss them and apologise for mistakes. A happy family is not problem-free; its members care for others and work together.
